We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no description of the compound. We can get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Use proton NMR to see signals around 0.9 ppm (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon ~10-30 ppm.

We need to decide which tool to use. Probably proton_nmr_spectra is cheaper than carbon? Both cost. Use proton first.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
